text: Imagine waking up famous. It's six fourteen, and your day already belongs to a thousand other people.
Your phone is full of requests. Before you can answer, your team is waiting outside.
First comes training. Even on a quiet morning, somebody is counting on you to be ready.
You change, grab your coffee, and head for the car. The city is only just waking up.
But outside the window, someone recognizes you. One camera becomes ten.
At the studio, you switch on the smile, answer the questions, and try to make it look effortless.
Then a fan calls your name. You stop, sign their photo, and for a moment the noise disappears.
By evening, the lights are still on. One more appearance, one more wave, one more perfect picture.
Finally, the door closes. The world sees the spotlight. You get the silence that comes after it.
